hero.title:
Vibe Coding
Anytime, Anywhere.
hero.subtitle: Go for a hike, grab a coffee, or just relax. Your AI agents work in the background. Get native app or messaging app notifications when they need your input.
hero.appsNote: Native iOS, Android and macOS apps are paid (the App Store purchase also runs on Apple silicon Macs). The web app/PWA is free.

showcase.title:
Start on Desktop.
Continue Anywhere. Switch Back Anytime.
showcase.subtitle: Your session lives on your machine. Your phone is just a window. Work locally in your agent's own terminal UI, switch to remote when away, double-space to switch back instantly.

localCore.title: Local Core
localCore.desc: Heavy lifting happens on your powerful desktop machine. No cloud limits.

remoteControl.title: Remote Control
remoteControl.desc: Continue sessions from native iOS, Android and macOS apps, the PWA, or the Telegram Mini App.

modeSwitch.title: Switch Freely
modeSwitch.desc: Move between terminal and mobile seamlessly. Double-space to return to local. Session state stays in sync.

startAnywhere.title: Start Anywhere
startAnywhere.desc: Launch Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and more directly from your phone.

seamlessChat.title: Seamless Chat
seamlessChat.desc: Continue your coding conversation exactly where you left off.

reviewCode.title: Review Code
reviewCode.desc: Full syntax highlighting for reviewing changes on the go.

fullTerminal.title: Full Terminal Access
fullTerminal.desc: Execute commands and manage your environment remotely through the web app's terminal.

powerfulCommands.title: Powerful Commands
powerfulCommands.desc: Use your agent's slash commands, like /review, right from the composer.

manageWorkspaces.title: Manage Workspaces
manageWorkspaces.desc: Switch between multiple active sessions and worktrees instantly.

lifestyle.title: The "Vibe Coding" Lifestyle
lifestyle.subtitle: HAPI isn't just a tool; it's a declaration of independence from your desk.

explore.title: Go Explore
explore.desc: Agents run locally on your powerful desktop. You? You're miles away, enjoying the view.

sip.title: Sip & Approve
sip.desc: Get a ping on your phone. Review the plan. Tap "Approve". Go back to your latte.

walk.title: Walk Away
walk.desc: Literally. Walk away from the screen. HAPI keeps the session alive and secure until you return.

features.title: Power When You Need It
features.subtitle: Everything you need to run real coding work from anywhere, without giving up the tools you already use.

agents.title: Your Agent, Your Choice
agents.desc: HAPI wraps the official agent CLIs instead of replacing them. Same terminal, same experience, one unified workflow for remote control.
agents.hint: Start any of them with hapi <agent>, or run hapi to pick one.

apps.title: Native Apps + PWA
apps.desc: Paid native apps for iOS, Android and macOS, plus a free, full-featured web app that installs as a PWA.

passkey.title: Passkey Sign-in
passkey.desc: Sign in with Face ID, Touch ID, Windows Hello or a security key. The same passkey works in the web app and the native apps.

relay.title: Encrypted Relay
relay.desc: Run hapi hub --relay for a public URL with no port forwarding. Traffic is end-to-end encrypted with WireGuard + TLS; the relay only forwards opaque packets.

notifications.title: Push Notifications
notifications.desc: Get notified when a session needs input, asks for permission, fails or completes, via native push, Web Push, Telegram and more.

peers.title: Peer Sessions
peers.desc: Agents can list, inspect, message and spawn other HAPI sessions, so one agent can delegate work to another.

branch.title: Fork, Branch & Rewind
branch.desc: Fork a conversation, rewind to an earlier message, or branch from a user turn into a new Claude Code or Codex session, even across harnesses. Availability depends on the agent.

steer.title: Mid-turn Steer
steer.desc: Send a follow-up while the agent is still working and steer it into the running turn, on agents that support it.

sessions.title: Find Any Session
sessions.desc: Search, sort and filter your sessions, with active, archived and unread views, on the web and in the native apps.

voice.title: Voice Control
voice.desc: Talk to your agent hands-free with the web voice assistant, or dictate messages and review them before sending.

usage.title: Usage & Plan Quota
usage.desc: Track token usage across sessions and see your agent accounts' plan quotas and rate limits in Settings → Usage.

jobs.title: Session-attached Jobs
jobs.desc: Long-running work that outlives the agent, like batch imports or overnight scripts, shows its progress right on the session list.

terminal.title: Full Terminal Access
terminal.desc: Open a terminal in your phone's browser or the desktop web app to run commands on your working machine.

step1.title: 1. Start on Desktop
step1.desc: Launch HAPI on your machine. It keeps your session alive and ready for remote access.

step2.title: 2. Connect Mobile
step2.desc: Open the free web app/PWA or Mini App, or pair the native iOS, Android or macOS app with your hub to control your sessions.

step3.title: 3. Vibe Code
step3.desc: Let agents do the heavy lifting. Approve changes, run commands, and enjoy your freedom.

npm.step3Hint: URL and QR code shown in terminal
npm.step2Hint: Or start an agent directly with npx @twsxtd/hapi claude, … codex, … cursor and so on. Installed globally, it's just hapi <agent>.

cta.title: Ready to Vibe?
cta.subtitle: Join the revolution. Stop watching progress bars and start enjoying your life.

footer.desc:
Vibe Coding Anytime, Anywhere.
The local-first AI agent platform for developers who love freedom.
